ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Guaranteed income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmers.
Access to credit card facilities (Kisan Credit Card) with subsidized interest rates.
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar Number and Captcha.
Select State, District, Block, and Village, then enter land details and upload land records.
Submit the form. State government authorities will verify and approve details.
Funds will be disbursed once verification is successful.

faqs.question: Is there any income limit for PM Kisan?
faqs.answer: No specific income limit, but institutional landholders, government employees, and income tax payers are excluded.

faqs.question: Can joint landholders apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, joint landholders can also apply for the benefits proportionally as per government rules.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one of enrollment.
No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
application_steps: Check eligibility on the PMJAY portal (mera.pmjay.gov.in) using your mobile number or Ration Card.
Visit an empanelled government or private hospital or a CSC center.
Present your Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to the Ayushman Mitra.
Get your Ayushman Golden Card generated after biometrics verification.
Avail cashless treatments directly at empanelled healthcare facilities.

faqs.question: Does Ayushman Bharat cover private hospitals?
faqs.answer: Yes, it covers cashless treatment in both empanelled public and private hospitals across India.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on family members?
faqs.answer: No, all family members listed in the household database can use the card. There is no size limit.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans under CLSS for EWS/LIG categories.
Financial assistance up to ₹1.5 Lakhs for construction of new houses or enhancement of existing ones.
Empowerment: The house must be owned or co-owned by a female head of the family.
required_documents: Affidavit stating that you do not own any pucca house anywhere in India
application_steps: Log in to the official PMAY portal (pmaymis.gov.in).
Select 'Citizen Assessment' and choose 'Benefit under other 3 components' or 'Slum Dwellers'.
Enter Aadhaar details and fill out the detailed application form containing income, family, and contact details.
Save the system-generated application number for tracking.
Wait for physical verification by local municipal authorities.

faqs.question: Can I apply if my family owns a home in my native village?
faqs.answer: No, the applicant and their family members must not own a pucca house in any part of India to be eligible.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC / SC / ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: 100% reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees charged by educational institutions.
Monthly maintenance allowance ranging from ₹300 to ₹1,200 depending on course groups and hostel status.
required_documents: Student ID Card / Proof of Admission
Income Certificate of parents (annual income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs)
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Complete registration and log in using the Student Application ID.
Fill out course, academic, and basic profiling details.
Upload scanned copies of required documents including Fee Receipt, Caste/Income certificates.
Submit and forward the digital copy to your school/college institute for verification.

faqs.question: Can general category students apply?
faqs.answer: No, this scholarship is specifically for students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories. General category students with low income should explore EBC scholarships.

ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Monthly direct benefit transfer (DBT) of ₹1,250 into the beneficiary woman's bank account.
required_documents: Bank Passbook (linked with Aadhaar & DBT enabled)
application_steps: Visit the designated Gram Panchayat / Ward Office or Camp in MP.
Get the application form printed out, fill in your Samagra ID and Aadhaar.
Provide biometrics at the registration counter setup by the municipal officials.
Get a printed acknowledgment receipt with a unique application ID.
Verify that your bank account has e-KYC and active DBT status.

faqs.question: Can unmarried women apply for Ladli Behna?
faqs.answer: No, this scheme is currently only for married, widowed, divorced, or abandoned women aged 21-60.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 for citizens aged 60-79 years.
Increased monthly pension of ₹500 for senior citizens aged 80 years and above.
States usually add matching contributions, bringing total pension up to ₹1,000 - ₹3,000 depending on the state.
required_documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate or School Leaving Certificate)
BPL Card (Below Poverty Line) or Income Certificate
application_steps: Obtain the application form from the Social Welfare Department, Gram Panchayat, or Block Development Office.
Attach required documents, including age proof and BPL card verification.
Submit the application to the Gram Panchayat or Ward Office.
Social Welfare inspectors will verify eligibility through field visits.
Once approved, the pension is deposited monthly in the Aadhaar-linked bank account.

faqs.question: Do I need a BPL card for IGNOAPS?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL) to qualify under central guidelines.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Free permanent registration number and digital certificate.
Collateral-free loans under CGTMSE and sub-vention on loan interest rates.
Exemption in government tenders, energy bills, and patent filing costs.
application_steps: Go to the official Udyam Registration portal (udyamregistration.gov.in).
Enter Aadhaar number and name, click on Validate and Generate OTP.
Enter PAN card details and specify organization type.
Provide plant location, investment figures, and annual turnover details.
Submit the form and instantly download the Udyam Registration Certificate.

faqs.question: Is registration free?
faqs.answer: Yes, government registration is completely free of charge. Do not pay any private portals.

ministry: Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Uttar Pradesh
benefits: Financial incentive up to ₹35,000 for disabled couples upon marriage (₹15,000 if husband is disabled, ₹20,000 if wife is disabled, and ₹35,000 if both are disabled).
application_steps: Visit the UP Divyangjan Shadi portal (divyangjan.upsdc.gov.in).
Fill the online registration form within one year of marriage.
Upload Aadhaar, Marriage certificate, Domicile certificate, and Disability certificate.
Submit the hard copy along with documents to the District Disabled Welfare Office within 15 days.
Approved incentive is directly transferred to the joint bank account.

faqs.question: What is the minimum percentage of disability required?
faqs.answer: The applicant must possess a valid Disability Certificate certifying at least 40% or higher disability.
